name: spanalyzer-issue-cli-42545604a8
stderr:
Usage of ./gateway_main:
  -copy_emulator_stderr
    	If true, the gateway will copy the emulator's stderr to its stderr. (default true)
  -copy_emulator_stdout
    	If true, the gateway will copy the emulator's stdout to its stdout.
  -disable_query_null_filtered_index_check
    	If true, then queries that use NULL_FILTERED indexes will be answered.
  -enable_fault_injection
    	If true, the emulator will inject faults at runtime (e.g. randomly abort commit requests to allow testing application abort-retry behavior).
  -grpc_binary string
    	Location of the grpc binary. (default "emulator_main")
  -grpc_port int
    	Port on which to run the emulator grpc server. (default 9010)
  -hostname string
    	Hostname for the emulator servers. (default "localhost")
  -http_port int
    	Port on which to run the emulator http server. (default 9020)
  -log_requests
    	If true, gRPC requests and responses will be logged to stdout.
  -notices
    	If true, the emulator will print all third-party notices to stdout.
  -override_change_stream_partition_token_alive_seconds int
    	If set to X seconds, and X is greater than 0, then override the default partition token alivetime from 20-40 seconds(default for Emulator only, not for production Spanner) to X-2X seconds. (default -1)
  -override_max_databases_per_instance int
    	If set at a value greater than the default limit of Spanner, overrides the allowed maximum number of databases per instance. If the MAX_DATABASES_PER_INSTANCE environment variable is set, it overrides the value set in this flag but it is only respected if it's greater than the default limit of Spanner. (default 100)
  -remote_functions_host_port string
    	The host:port to use for remote functions.
